articles.title: Inflation Pushes Past Expectations Amid US-Iran Tensions
articles.description: Canada's annual inflation rate increased to 3% in July, driven by rising gasoline prices due to US-Iran tensions and higher travel costs. Analysts had predicted a slightly lower rise. Core inflation remains stable, likely prompting the Bank of Canada to hold its policy rate steady.

articles.title: Rupee falls 19 paise to close at 95.61 against U.S. dollar

articles.title: Trump Prioritizes Nuclear Non-Proliferation Over Energy Stability Amid West Asia Tensions
articles.description: President Donald Trump reinforces his stance on preventing Iran from developing nuclear weapons, highlighting it as Washington's top priority amid the ongoing conflict with Tehran. This emphasis contrasts with Vice President JD Vance's previous remarks prioritizing energy security and stable oil and gas prices. The administration faces internal and external pressures.

articles.title: "Iran cannot have, in any way, shape, or form, a Nuclear Weapon": Trump reiterates US' "number one Goal"
articles.description: US President Donald Trump on Monday reiterated that preventing Iran from obtaining a nuclear weapon remains Washington's "number one Goal" in the ongoing conflict with Tehran in West Asia, placing a renewed emphasis on the nuclear issue despite some of his advisers highlighting energy security and keeping oil and gas prices low as equally important priorities.

articles.title: Second wave of fuel shortages at gas stations sweeps across Russia
articles.description: Fuel shortages have returned to some regions of Russia in August, prompting local authorities in at least 10 regions to again tighten controls on sales of motor fuel at petrol stations, according to authorities and regional media.

articles.title: US stock futures mixed as investors await Fed minutes, retail earnings
articles.description: US stock futures traded near flat as investors assessed the Federal Reserve's rate outlook following a third straight weekly gain for the S&P 500. Retail earnings, Fed meeting minutes and oil prices are in focus this week, while Vista Energy shares jumped after Peter Thiel's hedge fund disclosed a stake worth about $76 million.

articles.description: Chief Economic Adviser V Anantha Nageswaran advocates reintroducing lower ethanol petrol blends like E10 alongside E20 to ease public concerns, protect older vehicles, and balance environmental and economic impacts in India’s fuel policy.
